newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay stocks slide halted, index claws back gains.
newsitem.headline: Bombay stocks slide halted, index claws back gains.

text.p: ** (1100 GMT) - Bombay shares climb up marginally from
day's lowest levels, halting market slide
** Bombay 30-share index loses 94.48 points, or 2.19 pct,
** Market pauses after initial knee-jerk reaction as
regional Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK) party says
plans to pull out of Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral's
ruling United Front govt citing differences with
** Traders see no immediate threat to Gujral's govt as DMK
says will continue to support Gujral's government
** Foreign funds stay on the sidelines in limited trade,
